description: Send a workspace invitation. Fillo emails the address, and accepting gives that person access to every form, response, and setting in the workspace at the role you pick. That is mail leaving Fillo to a person, and access changing — pass confirm=true when the user authorized this address and role. Otherwise ask for their decision. You can never grant a role above the acting person's own. Needs members:manage.

confirm.description: Set true when the user has authorized this action on the specified target in the task or workflow. Ask only if that authorization is missing.

name: fillo_invite_member
title: Invite someone to the workspace
